thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: p99 latency breach detected in prod-us-west (service: inference-api). p99 = 1.35s (> alert 1.2s) over last 5m. Triggered alerts: p99-latency-prod-us-west, stream-stalls-detect.
Jordan (oncall): I'm on it. starting quick checks: dashboard, recent deploys, and autoscaler status.
Maya (sre): taking realtime dashboards. p95 is 420ms up from baseline 120ms, p99 1.35s, tail > 2s for some streaming sessions. Spike started ~ 3581239800 (a few mins ago).
Rashid (runtime): any recent runtime rollouts? we pushed a kernel-selector change an hour ago to improve throughput on 13B models.
Li (eng-platform): we rolled kernel-selector v2.3.1 -> v2.4 at 3581239000 (canary then gradual). Canary looked ok. I'll check rollout state.
Carla (support): I'm pulling customer-impact: CS dashboards show 3 high-traffic customers in us-west with elevated error rates in streaming: intermittent stalls and reconnects. Sending heads up to account owners.
Jordan (oncall): first mitigation: shift traffic away from the affected pool. ops-bot, can you divert new requests for rdm-13b-quant to fallback pool rdm-13b-8bit-ded?
ops-bot: Command queued: `rictl routing set --model rdm-13b-quant --region us-west --fallback rdm-13b-8bit-ded --drain 60s` — started.
Maya (sre): visual: here's the graphs (copied): p99 host-level shows 2 nodes with tail spikes correlating with high kernel compile times. KV cache miss rate jumped from 5% to 42% at the same window.
Rashid (runtime): kv-cache spike is suspicious. Could be a cache eviction bug after the kernel change (we touched KV affinity). I'll check logs.
Li (eng-platform): rollback candidate: kernel-selector v2.4 -> v2.3.1. Recommend pausing rollout while we confirm. If rollback, do in staging then prod canary immediate rollback.
Jordan (oncall): agree — pause rollout. Li, can you pause and start rollback on canary? Rashid, check whether draining and fallback reduce p99.
Li (eng-platform): pausing rollout now. Command: `ciops deploy pause --name=kernel-selector-v2.4` -> done. Initiating rollback on canary: `ciops deploy rollback --name=kernel-selector-v2.4 --to=2.3.1 --scope=canary`
Maya (sre): after divert already, p99 dropped to 980ms in 90s. still above SLO. streaming stalls reduced but tail still noisy.
Rashid (runtime): log snippet showing KV eviction errors: ```
[2026-03-15T14:29:12Z] WARN kvcache: eviction unexpected, reason=affinity-mismatch, key_count=0x3a
[2026-03-15T14:29:14Z] ERROR serve: stream stall detected, session_id=xyz, last_token_ts=+4s
```
Rashid (runtime): looks like the kernel change included a cache placement tweak that mis-classified some table shards. rolling that back should restore locality.
Carla (support): Customer impact: 3 enterprise tenants saw degraded interactive latency; one reported a resumed session with stale partial output (they retried and all OK post-diversion). I've opened tickets and sent proactive notes.
Jordan (oncall): Ops: scale up an extra 12 GPUs in us-west pool (temp) to reduce queuing while rollback completes. ops-bot?
ops-bot: `rictl capacity adjust --pool us-west-inference --delta +12 --reason "incident 3581239999 temporary scale"` -> accepted, scaling started (target healthy in ~2m).
Maya (sre): Traces: sampled spans show long kernel-compile times up to 1.2s on a subset of requests that do heavy token expansion. Those align to hosts where kernel-selector decided to JIT a new kernel variant.
Li (eng-platform): rollback canary succeeded; starting prod rollback now. Command: `ciops deploy rollback --name=kernel-selector-v2.4 --to=2.3.1 --scope=prod` ( ETA ~3m )
Rashid (runtime): while rollback runs, I'm enabling temporary KV-cache replication mode to reduce misses: `./tools/kvctl set-mode --mode=replicate-temp --ttl 30m` -> done. Monitoring effects.
Maya (sre): p99 now at 520ms and trending down, p95 back to ~180ms. Streaming stalls count dropped 70% since diversion + cache tweak.
Jordan (oncall): Good. Action items: 1) Li verify full rollback complete and post-rollback checks. 2) Rashid follow up with root-cause analysis on kernel-selector affinity change. 3) Maya keep monitoring for 30m and escalate if p99 > 800ms. 4) Carla continue CS comms.
Li (eng-platform): prod rollback finished at 3581240300. Verified canary->prod state consistent with 2.3.1. No regressions in staging.
Rashid (runtime): collected core logs and reproducer; filing infra ticket #INF-4872 with steps and patch.
Carla (support): I've sent a status update to impacted accounts and set expectation for a root-cause update in 24h.
Maya (sre): I'll keep the incident open and watch metrics. If stable for 30m, we'll mark as mitigated and start the postmortem workflow.
Jordan (oncall): marking initial triage done. Mitigation status: traffic diverted, prod rollback applied, temp capacity added, KV replicate enabled. Current impact: degraded but recovering; several customers were affected briefly and notified.
ops-bot: Incident state: MITIGATED -> monitoring. Next steps: schedule postmortem huddle 24h window.
Jordan (oncall): :thumbsup: thanks team. tagging for postmortem: @Rashid, @Li, @Maya, @Carla. I'll handoff to Maya in 30m unless further alerts.
Maya (sre): taking post-handoff watch. I'll update channel if anything spikes.
incidents-bot: Note: create-incident-doc suggested. `incident create --id 3581239999 --severity=sev2 --services=inference-api --summary="p99 latency spike due to kernel-selector affinity regression"`
Jordan (oncall): creating doc now and linking tickets.
Carla (support): closing loop with accounts in thread and setting ETA for RCA doc.
Maya (sre): end of thread for now.
